title: Learning the Bitter Lesson: Empirical Evidence from 20 Years of CVPR Proceedings

live_model.evidence: "We employ three large language models to evaluate the title and abstracts of CVPR papers from 2005 to 2024: GPT-4o-2024-05-13, gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18, and claude-3-5-sonnet-20240620."

prompt.location: "The prompts used in this study are included in the appendix for reproducibility."
prompt.note: CoT prompting via the Magentic library; Likert 0-10 scoring across 5 'bitter lesson' dimensions, anchored with 0/5/10 examples.

claim.metric: R-squared, regression of overall bitter-lesson alignment score (GPT-4o-scored) on citation count

data.source: CVPR proceedings titles/abstracts (2005-2024) + Semantic Scholar citation-count API

notes: Full dataset is ~200 randomly sampled CVPR papers/year x 20 years (171 in 2024 specifically); gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18 and claude-3-5-sonnet-20240620 are scored identically and could serve as secondary claims. Inter-model scoring agreement (ICC, Krippendorff's alpha) is reported in Figure 3.
